item.text: [{"task_id":"e179c5f4","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    marker = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    background = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    lower = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    unit = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    row_step = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    col_step = int(round(params['rule'][5]))","    positions = np.argwhere(grid == marker)","    if len(positions) == 0:","        return grid.copy()","    h, w = grid.shape","    row = int(positions[0][0])","    col = int(positions[0][1])","    out = np.full(grid.shape, background, dtype=int)","    for k in range(h):","        out[(row + k * row_step) % h, col % w] = marker","        next_col = col + col_step","        if next_col < lower or next_col > w - unit:","            col_step = -col_step","        col = col + col_step","    return out"],"shapes":{"rule":[6]},"params":{"rule":[1,8,0,1,-1,1]},"rationale":"Fill with 8 and extend the bottom seed upward as a diagonal of 1s, reflecting horizontally at each edge."}]
